data.content_ref: inline:The 'Variance Floor' mechanism in 00321f6b7b18 integrates with the 'Algorithmic Floor' effect in 051b3183aa966e6232f1e635aa7259bf92ad1c5ad996954879f69a27783391d3 by defining the specific failure modes (black swan failures vs cognitive variability) that the deterministic process eliminates; this relation is refuted if the 'Variance Floor' is found to be a distinct outcome rather than a component of the 'Algorithmic Floor' process.
